1.title: Champion of champions!!
1.msg:
Congratulations on the win 🏆 you king 🤑 

You have made it into the history books in a big way! 

Your name is being engraved at this very moment on the main wall of FIFA's official museum. 

Enjoy the money and the glory, you deserve it 😏

2.title: Congrats, you star!
2.msg:
You won money! (literally 🥈) 

Well done 💪 an impressive achievement! 

So go buy yourself something nice 👗 

And don't believe those who say nobody remembers number 2 — with us you'll always stay in the statistics

3.title: Hello there 🥉!
3.msg:
You took third place and a tidy prize... 💲💲 

So maybe you won't fulfill all your dreams, but come on, that's decent money! 

The hard work paid off in the end, congrats!

4.title: Break Even
4.msg:
You can relax, call the banker and cancel the mortgage on the apartment 🏠 

You finished fourth and won back all your money 💵 

It was tense, it wasn't easy, but in the end you did it!

5.title: So close to the cash
5.msg:
You were so close to a prize-winning spot,

the money just slipped right through your fingers 💸

and you were left with only the compliments...

Still, you made it into the top five — pat yourself on the back!

6_7.title: Not far from glory
6_7.msg:
You were close, but couldn't get your hands on one of the prizes... 

The good news: 

the Euros start in less than two years! 

This is your chance to win back the money you lost here... 

and more 😏

8_9.title: A good spot in the middle 😑
8_9.msg:
You didn't take any money, 

you weren't relegated, 

mediocre... 

There's nothing interesting to say about you 

Keep being average, we love you just the way you are!

10_13.title: Not your tournament
10_13.msg:
You're in the bottom half of the table, that's nothing special... 

but in such a surprising World Cup, it says more about the Qatari refereeing than about your talent 

Go speak your truth 🎤

14.title: At least you're not last, bro
14.msg:
No matter how much you missed, 

always remember there was someone worse than you... 

Never be the tail of the foxes!
🦊

But next year you'd better do better, it's a shame about the money 😏

15.title: Last but adds a lot
15.msg:
You finished last, 

but you proved you're smarter than the monkey 🙈, that counts for something too!

Maybe we'll make it next year...

1.title: Congratulations!!
1.msg:
You finished in first place! 🏆 

Your name is being engraved at this very moment on the coveted trophy, and will forever remain etched in the hall of fame. 

Well done 👏👏
